config.alignment: Offthread WordPiece heuristics; shared across models
config.hybrid: deduplicate exact span+type, regex provenance wins ties; retain differing types; union intervals for masking

models.name: BERT base · NER
models.scope: General NER: person, organization, location; MISC excluded

models.name: DistilBERT multilingual · NER
models.scope: Multilingual NER: person, organization, location; Chinese is an exploratory slice

corpus.unit: Alice Morgan works at Acme Labs in London. Email alice@example.com.
corpus.note: Repetitive synthetic throughput workload, not a quality or representative-document benchmark. Same text is used for every model; actual tokenizer counts differ. Long inputs are chunked.

methodology.cpu: Chrome-reported cumulative CPU seconds sampled for all processes in a dedicated Chrome instance; 100% = one logical core. Polling overhead included; exited-between-samples processes can be missed.
methodology.memory: OS ps RSS summed across Chrome process IDs, in MiB. Includes browser/runtime/shared-page double counting; not model-exclusive memory or JS heap. Sampling can miss brief peaks.
methodology.firstResult: Complete detection result, including download/initialization for firstLoad. Not generation TTFT.
methodology.tokens: Actual tokenizer input lengths per chunk, including repeated special tokens. Preflight token counting is included in inference latency. No output-token generation.
methodology.trials: 30 short, 5 4K, 3 32K, 1 100K; five short warmups before measured inference. Single long run has no p95.
methodology.cache: New temporary browser context per model; firstLoad has empty context caches but OS/CDN/network caches are not controlled.
methodology.workload: One repetitive synthetic English template; same files across models. Not a representative document or accuracy benchmark.
